subject: 临安皇城北向门楼意象，ch02南宋1223（无字原创意象，门名形制待考）
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu default building-map, a single reusable transparent PNG building, realistic historical Chinese architectural materials, no ink painting or miniature toy. Orthographic dimetric 2:1 projection, yaw45 pitch30, two horizontal ground axes have screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical pillars exactly vertical, NO perspective convergence. Front faces screen lower left. Grey clay tiles, weathered timber, understated plaster and stone, believable Song-period structural joinery, low-saturation warm natural colors. Thin flat rectangular footprint foundation, clearly visible straight front and right base edges, no chunky diorama pedestal. Entire building including eaves and thin footprint inside canvas, at least 10% transparent padding on all sides. Sunlight from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short subtle contact shadow toward SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. TRUE transparent RGBA canvas, no background sky, floor, scenery or checkerboard. No text, signs, pseudo-writing, letters, watermark, logo, humans, modern objects, Qing yellow palace roofs, Japanese torii, dramatic extreme eaves. Generate exactly ONE asset in a square 1024x1024 composition. ONE complete restrained Southern Song Linan palace gateway building 14m east-west by8m north-south footprint. Broad single-storied timber gate hall above a modest grey stone gate base, one central open passage continuing north to south, muted cinnabar structural columns, sparse large bracket clusters, shallow grey tiled hipped roof with restrained ridge ends, NO yellow tiles or Qing ornament. The formal entrance is on its NORTH SIDE (screen upper-right, far side); visible south rear opening faces lower-left. Entire flat rectangular thin plinth visible in a 14:8 ground ratio, straight front and right edges, no neighboring palace, no external city wall, no banner, no written plaque. Cinematic realistic material fidelity but mathematically orthographic framing.
CORRECTION: the rectangular ground footprint must truly be14m x8m, not a long narrow14x5 strip. Show a DEEP rectangular gatehouse foundation. On a square image, base corners roughly at LEFT(15%,68%), FRONT(59.55%,90.275%), RIGHT(85%,77.55%), BACK(40.45%,55.275%); the two ground axes are exactly+0.5 and-0.5, ratio of visible frontage run to visible depth run is14/8=1.75. Treat this as engineering geometry; roof and walls follow these same axes, no perspective convergence. Ignore any source image ground distortion. More transparent padding around eaves. Cast only a tiny contact shadow immediately DOWN-RIGHT, no wide shadow on upper-right.
negative: 无文字、现代元素、人物、透视、厚台基、背景色或棋盘格
created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 三稿均view_image，选择第2稿：完整宋式灰瓦门楼、南北贯通，无字无人；主光左上、短影右下。第1稿台基过长窄，第3稿仍浅斜且更窄。第2稿底面仍+.448/-.427、宽深比1.489 vs1.75，几何未通过；地台相对目标偏厚。仅candidate，严禁作为已通过精确拼接/历史复原素材。
